name: Colombia IDEAM 10-minute rainfall stations (datos.gov.co)
short: IDEAM rainfall totals every 10 minutes at stations across Colombia via the open-data portal. Free, no key.
summary: Colombia's national weather and environment institute (IDEAM) publishes rain recorded every 10 minutes at stations across the country as an open dataset on datos.gov.co (Socrata, SODA JSON API). Each record has station code and name, department, municipality, hydrographic zone, latitude, longitude, sensor description, unit (mm) and the observed value with its time. The description says it has basic WMO-recommended quality control, with failing values corrected or removed, and that it can support early warning systems. Update frequency is stated as daily. A keyless GET sorted by time on 2026-11-07 UTC returned records stamped 2026-11-06 23:59 local time.

latency.notes: Readings are 10-minute but the dataset is refreshed daily, so this is near-real-time, not minutes.

Provenance flagged official. The portal's own terms of use were not read. Automated access, AI training and resale are not addressed.
